card.title: IPhone X image no centered and iphone restarting

source.title: IPhone X image no centered and iphone restarting

claims.statement: iPhone X with the Apple logo shifted to the right is usually a cracked GPU coil L2780 (BUCK8_LX0) next to the CPU; spec 1 µH 20% 2.5 A 0.052 Ω.
Logo shifted to the lower part of the screen points to an open filter FL5780 on PP1V8_DISPLAY_CONN; spec 33 Ω 25% 1500 mA.

procedure: Try a new screen; inspect FPC.
Logo right: split board, replace L2780, test in iSocket, reball.
Logo low: replace FL5780 near the LCD FPC.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
